b: Me and my husband just moved into a new house less than a month ago. I think getting a house has gotten to his head. I am the handy gall in the relationship, I am the one fixing things around the house (he doesn't use a screwdriver very well), painted everything, cleaned the carpets. I am the only one that cooks but I don't really mind. He now thinks hes the "man of the house " and deserves to get everything served. Rudely (jokingly, he says) asks where is his food, how come i haven't put water in the fridge, to serve him desert after serving him dinner and if i say I'm tired or cold and dont feel like getting up (he doesn't like putting the thermostat high) that I dont love him enough to go get him what he wants. Today I said he should get himself some cake (after serving him dinner and ice cream) he tried convincing me saying if I loved him I would have cake ready after his shower and how nice it'll be to have cake I served him because i do it better. I didn't do it. He got upset, served his cake and went to bed without talking to me. I cried. I don't know how to get him to understand i dont appreciate how he says I don't love him just because I'm not serving him every time he feels like asking for something. I help as much as I can but I'm not his maid.
We both work full time btw.

Edit. Thank you to every that replied. I typed this all out and went to bed. I guess he noticed me on the bed after a couple hours because he got up and went to sleep in the living room. Good times /s . I actually feel pretty sad about him leaving to sleep somewhere else but from the comments I understand I need to let him be because I can't let him train me into being his maid.
For the one comment, we pay half the mortgage each.
